SK Virtual Cash Register (VRP2) — Connection

The connection to Finančná správa's virtual cash register (VRP 2) shared by the invoice-payment and Point of Sale modules.

Version19.0.2.4.0
EditionCommunity and Enterprise
LicenceAGPL-3
Requiresaccount
Extended byl10n_sk_vrp2_account, pos_vrp2
This module is part of a family documented in one place. The full guide: l10n_sk_vrp2_account

Connects Odoo to the Slovak virtual cash register (VRP 2): the login of the company's own register in Accounting → Configuration → Settings, block VRP2 - Slovak Virtual Cash Register, with Login / Logout, the register's details as VRP reports them (DKP, business name, DIČ, IČO, IČ DPH) and the Round to 0.05 € setting. Each Point of Sale till uses the same mechanism with its own login.

It does nothing on its own. It is installed by l10n_sk_vrp2_account (invoice payments) and pos_vrp2 (sales at the till), whose guides describe how to use it.
